mediumNote: This kit provides a text channel only. A voice condition is out of scope unless the researcher runs it with external tooling that applies the same delays and logs.

conditions.note: Interrupted delivery. Messages that would arrive during an outage are held and delivered when it ends.
Interrupted delivery. Messages that would arrive during an outage are held and delivered when it ends.
Exploratory. Messages that would arrive during the outage are lost. Participants must be told in the briefing that loss is possible.
